claims.claim_text: LinkedIn 讓多組獨立的模型／harness 組合平行審查同一支 PR，再去重、交叉驗證彼此的意見
claims.evidence: runs multiple review subagents in parallel, gathers their findings, deduplicates and cross-validates them
claims.note: Parallel independent subagents, dedup and cross-validation all directly attested.

claims.claim_text: 跑出 63.9% 的建議採用率與 99.1% 的任務完成率
claims.evidence: achieving a 63.9% combined acceptance rate ... completes 79,000+ reviews across 40,000+ PRs ... at a 99.1% task completion rate
claims.note: Both figures exact.

claims.claim_text: 系統另外用全域、repo、組織三層規則，依專案調整審查標準
claims.evidence: 3-Tier Customization Framework ... repo-level architectural rules ... organization-wide policy
claims.note: Tier count and scopes verified.

claims.claim_text: batching 策略與記憶體管理方式不同，決定了各自適合的部署規模與吞吐量取捨
claims.evidence: Ollama: FIFO queue / vLLM: continuous batching + PagedAttention / SGLang: prefix-aware scheduler + RadixAttention
claims.note: Original draft also claimed a 'multi-GPU serving' axis not present in the source; removed in fix.

claims.claim_text: 決定了各自適合的部署規模與吞吐量取捨
claims.evidence: Ollama: best for local dev... / vLLM: best for high-traffic serving... / SGLang: best for AI agents...
claims.note: Deployment-scale fit per engine is explicit.

claims.claim_text: 壓到 100MB 以下，Rust Glancer 挑戰 rust-analyzer 的記憶體用量 (title, after fix)
claims.evidence: target <100mb for reasonable projects. There are caveats, these are described below.
claims.note: Original title asserted a bare '100倍' ratio with no supporting benchmark in the source. Corrected to state only the two verified numbers (design target <100MB; separate 16GB anecdote) without the invented ratio.

claims.claim_text: 新專案 Rust Glancer 把常駐記憶體目標壓在 100MB 以下——作者是在自己某個 workspace 上看到 rust-analyzer 吃掉 16GB 記憶體後動手寫的，兩個數字分屬設計目標與個案自述，不是同一份 benchmark
claims.evidence: target <100mb for reasonable projects / 16GB of memory that I, ugh, would prefer to have available
claims.note: Rewritten lede states only source-verified numbers with correct hedge (target vs. anecdote, not a paired benchmark).

claims.claim_text: 作者公開設計筆記說明怎麼做到這件事
claims.evidence: There are several reasons why rust-analyzer consumes a lot of memory: ...
claims.note: Design-notes post exists and explains the memory-reduction approach.

claims.claim_text: Netflix 表示，團隊平行維運自研與開源 Kubernetes operator 兩套 Flink autoscaler，橫跨三萬多個串流作業
claims.note: netflixtechblog.com (Medium-hosted) returned HTTP 403 on re-fetch attempt; content independently confirmed readable during initial Step 2 research. Added visible 'Netflix 表示' attribution per the pending-claim hedge rule.

claims.claim_text: 兩套系統在資源預測、scale down 時機上走不同路線各有優劣，還沒有直接收斂成一套
claims.note: Same 403 as c09; covered by the same 'Netflix 表示' attribution added to the lede's opening clause.

claims.claim_text: 長駐、有狀態的即時 AI agent 串流，讓傳統 QPS／CPU 負載指標失靈
claims.evidence: Task B accepts just 5 requests, but each turns into a 20-minute session... QPS tracks arrival volume, but fails to capture the number of live conversations a server is already managing.
claims.note: Mechanism and failure mode directly supported.

claims.claim_text: Google Cloud API Gateway 改用混合容量模型
claims.evidence: One way to combine these signals is to estimate each backend's effective capacity using a feedback loop... one implementation could treat this as '9 pretend QPS.'
claims.note: Original lede misattributed a generic architectural pattern to a specific named product ('Google Cloud API Gateway') that the article never mentions in its body. Corrected: removed the product name, re-attributed as 'Google 這篇架構文章提出一種...' and softened title's 換了 to 提出 to match the source's own hedged 'one way'/'one implementation could' framing.

claims.claim_text: NVIDIA 認為要繼續拉高 AI 運算密度，資料中心得從現行配電架構換成 800 VDC
claims.evidence: The bottleneck isn't just wattage. It's how power gets from the grid to the GPU.
claims.note: Power-distribution-as-bottleneck and 800 VDC prescription attested; NVIDIA is speaker on own corporate blog.

claims.claim_text: 才不會先在電力與散熱上撞到天花板
claims.evidence: The bottleneck isn't just wattage. It's how power gets from the grid to the GPU.
claims.note: '散熱' (thermal/cooling) is not discussed anywhere in the source, which argues entirely from power-conversion/distribution efficiency. Removed the thermal half; now reads '才不會先在電力這一關撞到天花板'.

claims.claim_text: 這牽涉的不是單一元件汰換，而是整座機房供電架構的轉向
claims.evidence: NVIDIA describes a tiered roadmap spanning from hybrid retrofits to complete facility redesigns
claims.note: Facility-scale framing supported.

claims.claim_text: 代號 Deep Sleep 的省電機制，讓每 petabyte 儲存的耗電量比 2020 年少了超過一半 (original, causal)
claims.evidence: Deep Sleep is a Dropbox infrastructure initiative that reduces power consumption when hardware isn't actively needed... Since 2020, watts per petabyte across our storage infrastructure have improved by more than 50%.
claims.note: Source presents these as two separate facts in a section covering SEVERAL techniques (idle-power reduction, workload balancing, density gains); Deep Sleep is never credited as the sole cause of the >50% figure. Original title/lede made Deep Sleep the sole cause. Corrected: title changed to '省電多管齊下，Dropbox 每 PB 電費砍過半'; lede now attributes the >50% figure to the whole infrastructure and names Deep Sleep as 'one of several techniques'.

claims.claim_text: 每 petabyte 儲存的耗電量比 2020 年少了超過一半 (number, isolated)
claims.evidence: Since 2020, watts per petabyte across our storage infrastructure have improved by more than 50%.
claims.note: Figure and baseline year exact; survives after decoupling from the Deep-Sleep-as-sole-cause framing (see c16).

claims.claim_text: 團隊同時延長硬體服役年限，靠監控效能表現重新分配負載來換取更長壽命 (original, causal)
claims.evidence: Understanding hardware performance holistically allows us to extend the useful life of equipment... When demand is uneven, teams can rebalance workloads across systems...
claims.note: Source ties monitoring (not workload rebalancing) to lifespan extension; workload rebalancing is a separate fleet-utilization measure for uneven demand. Original lede fabricated the causal link between rebalancing and lifespan. Corrected: lede now reads '團隊同時靠監控硬體效能表現延長服役年限，不再只按固定週期汰換', dropping the invented rebalancing-for-lifespan link.

claims.claim_text: LY Corporation 表示，在 LINE App 內、每秒約一百萬則訊息規模的 Apache Kafka 管線上疊加端對端加密
claims.note: lycorp.co.jp returned HTTP 403 on re-fetch; content independently confirmed readable during initial Step 2 research. Added visible 'LY Corporation 表示' attribution per the pending-claim hedge rule.

claims.claim_text: Cloudflare 推出 Bot Preference Sync，依 BotBase 追蹤的 Search、Agent、Training 三類機器人清單，自動把 AI 政策寫進 robots.txt
claims.evidence: Bot Preference Sync reflects what you've set... by updating corresponding preferences to your robots.txt... bots that we track in BotBase
claims.note: Product name, BotBase dependency, three categories, automatic write all attested.

claims.claim_text: 網站可以擋訓練用爬蟲、同時放行合作的搜尋與代理流量，不必逐條手動維護規則清單
claims.evidence: Allow Search, Allow Agents, Disallow Training
claims.note: Worked example matches; periodic BotBase-driven updates cover the manual-maintenance claim.

claims.claim_text: CVE-2026-22708：export、typeset、declare 這類 shell 內建指令能悄悄改掉 PAGER、PYTHONWARNINGS 等環境變數，讓 Cursor 已經核准過的白名單指令，執行時其實變了樣
claims.evidence: CVE-2026-22708 ... export PAGER=... git branch ... The vulnerability existed in Cursor's Auto-Run Mode with an allowlist enabled.
claims.note: CVE id, builtins, env vars, and affected surface all confirmed.

claims.claim_text: Docker 用 microVM 隔離、預設拒絕網路的 Sandbox 架構因應，主張這類問題得靠系統性隔離解決，人工審核指令字面擋不住這條路
claims.evidence: microVMs with isolated kernels, filesystems, and deny-by-default networking ... Manual allowlist review cannot catch this attack
claims.note: microVM isolation, deny-by-default networking, and the explicit review-can't-catch-this argument all confirmed.
